description: Every answer a page collected, by name: a survey's responses (one per person, with the questions), or the page's data documents with who wrote each. Only the page's owner, or an admin of the company that owns it, may read them. Use it to summarize a survey, count sign-ups, or say who has not answered. Answers carry names and email addresses: report what the user asked, not the raw rows.

artifact_id.description: The Artifact id (art_…): the last part of its link, as in bisque.cloud/documents/art_…, /pages/art_… or /artifacts/art_….

name: read_artifact_results
title: Read what a page collected
